summary: Iter_17 soften-then-widen safety nets fully verified via /app/backend/tests/test_daily_summary_soften_widen.py (42 tests, ALL PASSED in ~55s including LIVE force_refresh call to Gemini). New rules in _build_prompt (SOLO como ÚLTIMO recurso, ACONTECIMIENTOS NACIONALES, Autocine Madrid, Cibeles/Neptuno tras victorias, MENCIÓNALO SIEMPRE en GRANDES EVENTOS, DEBERÍA, 'INCLUYE el bullet — no lo descartes por eso') are all present. _has_empty_event_sections correctly returns 3/3/0/2/1/2 across the 8 scenarios (None, empty, all-empty, all-full, 2-empty-1-full, 2-full-1-empty, 'Sin eventos verificados' variant, mixed). _retry_prompt_softer contains REINTENTO, REQUISITOS RELAJADOS, horario por confirmar, Cibeles, Autocine Madrid, Puerta del Sol, 2-3 bullets REALES. _strip_hallucinated_instructions removes 'NO RELLENES' from event sections, preserves it in [AEROPUERTO], leaves normal bullets alone, handles None/empty. _strip_stale_bullets FAIL-OPEN verified: a section that would go empty is preserved with a warning log; when at least one bullet survives, stale ones ARE dropped. _generate_summary_sync signature has extra_prompt kwarg with default None; temperature bumps 0.2 → 0.3 when provided (verified via a fake genai.Client capture). Retry orchestration integration verified: (a) when first pass returns 3/3 empty sections, a second _generate_summary_sync call is made WITH extra_prompt containing 'REINTENTO' and the full payload replaces the empty one; (b) when first pass is full, retry is NOT triggered (1 call only); (c) when retry ALSO comes back empty, the ORIGINAL payload is preserved (not overwritten). LIVE force_refresh returned 200 in ~50s with 3 real GRANDES EVENTOS bullets (ZZ Top Real Jardín Botánico, TARANTA GITANA CondeDuque, SQUIRT Teatro Calderón), 6 real TEATROS Y OCIO bullets (Il trovatore Teatro Real, Cristian Castro homenaje, Lonesome Shack Fun House, Fescinal MICHAEL+HACIENDO AMIGOS, Home Sweet Home, Somos Naturaleza), 4 real ALERTAS DE TRÁFICO bullets (Obras M-50, A-5, Calle Alcalá/Puerta Alcalá, restricciones camiones A-2/A-3/N-340), and a deterministic [AEROPUERTO] block with T1/T4-T4S peaks. ZERO 'NO RELLENES' or other hallucinated-marker contamination outside [AEROPUERTO]. Bug fix CONFIRMED WORKING.
live_summary_captured_on_2026-07-20: GRANDES EVENTOS=3 bullets, TEATROS Y OCIO=6 bullets, ALERTAS TRÁFICO=4 bullets, AEROPUERTO injected with 4 T1/T4-T4S peaks, elapsed 50.0s. Full text printed by teardown_module.

minor.issue: _strip_hallucinated_instructions uses substring match on lowercase — could false-positive on legitimate content like 'placeholder corto' if it ever appears in a real bullet. Currently safe because the marker list is narrow and specific to model artifacts, but worth revisiting if false positives are ever reported.

Router file has grown to ~1184 lines with multiple concerns (prompt building, Gemini call, verify pass, strip filters, retry orchestration, airport heuristic, section-tracker parser, public-widget adapter). Consider splitting into daily_summary/{prompt,gemini_client,filters,airport,public}.py for maintainability — exceeds the 700-line guideline.

Two vestigial variables in _strip_stale_bullets: `inside_target` and `dropped` are declared at the top of the first pass but the first pass no longer uses `inside_target` (per-section dict tracks it instead). Cosmetic only.

Optional (nice-to-have) code-review: refactor routers/daily_summary.py into a subpackage; it now exceeds 700 lines.
critical_code_review_comments: daily_summary.py:311-454 _build_prompt() — Softened REGLA #3 ('SOLO como ÚLTIMO recurso') and new REGLA #4 (ACONTECIMIENTOS NACIONALES with Cibeles/Neptuno/Colón/Puerta del Sol + Autocine Madrid RACE + Madrid Río + estadios) are exactly what the user's Mundial-de-fútbol complaint requires. Rule #6 correctly downgrades from DEBE to DEBERÍA and adds 'INCLUYE el bullet — no lo descartes por eso'. Well-structured.
daily_summary.py:673-681 _HALLUCINATED_MARKERS is a defensive whitelist of 7 patterns. Complete for the failure modes observed so far.

daily_summary.py:684-713 _strip_hallucinated_instructions correctly skips [AEROPUERTO] and only drops bullets outside it; safe with None/empty. Logs warnings when it drops something (good for observability).

daily_summary.py:604-666 _strip_stale_bullets refactored to two-pass architecture. Fail-open reversion (line 642-650) is the key improvement: when target section would be emptied, a WARNING is logged and body_lines are appended unchanged. Prevents the 'Sin información verificada' regression that the user reported.

daily_summary.py:716-810 _generate_summary_sync now accepts extra_prompt: Optional[str] with default None. Temperature bump 0.2→0.3 is line 736. Prompt concatenation uses double newline, safe against injection because extra_prompt is server-controlled.

daily_summary.py:960-1023 _generate_summary orchestration order: initial → retry-if-empty → verify → strip_stale → strip_hallucinated → inject_airport. All wrapped in try/except so any layer that fails leaves the previous text intact. Retry only replaces payload when retry_empty < empty_count — correctly prevents empty retries from overwriting non-empty originals.

daily_summary.py:904-931 _has_empty_event_sections is regex-based (matches '\n[SECTION]' next-header). Correctly handles all-caps ASCII-only section names but also would fail if a future section name uses lowercase; not a bug today but a fragility.

daily_summary.py:934-957 _retry_prompt_softer is well-scoped: acknowledges the previous empty output, relaxes constraints (2-3 bullets minimum, allow 'horario por confirmar'), lists concrete national-event examples, keeps the 'no ya-terminados' rule. Uses now.strftime('%A') for weekday which returns English on default locales — cosmetic only since it's inside a Spanish prompt but the model handles it fine.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter_17 test file /app/backend/tests/test_daily_summary_soften_widen.py is the primary regression for the soften-then-widen safety nets. It ships 5 unit test classes (prompt keywords, _has_empty_event_sections, _retry_prompt_softer, _strip_hallucinated_instructions, _strip_stale_bullets fail-open), 2 integration test classes (signature+temperature capture, retry orchestration with 3 scenarios), and 1 LIVE test that hits GET /api/events/daily-summary?force_refresh=true and enforces ≥2 real bullets per event section + zero 'NO RELLENES' contamination + [AEROPUERTO] terminal data. rca_of_the_issue: iter_16 introduced _strip_stale_bullets that empties sections when all bullets have past-dated ranges — combined with the aggressive verify pass this produced the user's iter_17 complaint: 3 event sections coming back with 'Sin información verificada para hoy.'. Root cause was two-fold: (1) the main _build_prompt rule set was too strict (DEBE include date range, otherwise DESCARTA), causing the model to over-discard rather than emit '(horario por confirmar)'; (2) _strip_stale_bullets had no fail-open safety net, so any section where Gemini emitted only past-dated bullets went empty. Fix applied by main agent in iter_17 addresses both: (a) softened REGLA #3 to 'SOLO como ÚLTIMO recurso' + softened rule #6 to DEBERÍA with 'INCLUYE el bullet — no lo descartes por eso', (b) new REGLA #4 ACONTECIMIENTOS NACIONALES mandating World Cup / Champions / San Silvestre / etc. be included with Cibeles/Neptuno/Colón/Autocine gathering points, (c) new _retry_prompt_softer path in _generate_summary that triggers a second Gemini call with extra_prompt='REINTENTO...' when ≥2 event sections come back empty (temperature bumped 0.2→0.3 for the retry), (d) fail-open guard in _strip_stale_bullets so a section is preserved when all its bullets would be dropped, (e) verify-pass fail-open when it removed >70% of bullets, (f) new _strip_hallucinated_instructions to strip the 'NO RELLENES' text that the model was copying from the [AEROPUERTO] instructions into other sections. All six safety nets tested. LIVE run on 2026-07-20 12:47 Madrid produced a fully populated summary with 13 real event bullets across the 3 event sections and zero 'NO RELLENES' leakage. Bug is resolved.
